question: What are the six limbs and which group of eight is named with them?
premises: The six limbs are declared as head, tuft, armor, eye, weapon, and the heart implied from the prior verse.
The group includes Sakala, Akala, Shunya, Kaladhya, Kha, and Kshapana as the last.
inference: The verse identifies the six limbs and continues the list of the eightfold group.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of all eight names is compressed across verses 368-369.
plain_english: They declare the six limbs to be the head, tuft, armor, eye, and weapon, together with the heart. Along with them are Sakala, Akala, Shunya, Kaladhya, Kha, and Kshapana as the last.
